speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a young patient presenting with wrist pain, fever, and skin lesions. To understand what is causing these symptoms, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing the fever and when the skin lesions first appeared?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lyme disease (Borrelia burgdorferi) causing septic arthritis of the wrist and skin lesions (Erythema Migrans or secondary infection).
